## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix

## Checklist

- [ ] `dart format .` applied (and `dart format --set-exit-if-changed .` passes).
- [ ] `flutter analyze` reports no issues.
- [ ] `flutter test` passes, and tests were added or updated for the change.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]` for user-visible changes.
- [ ] Screenshots or a short clip attached for UI changes.
- [ ] No secrets, keystores or build output committed.
